projects.name: Migration Master – High-Performance PostgreSQL Migration Tool
projects.description: High-performance database migration tool in C# (.NET 8) featuring native bulk binary COPY protocol and interactive CLI UI.

bullets.text: Built a high-performance PostgreSQL-to-PostgreSQL database migration tool in C# (.NET 8) using PostgreSQL's native Binary COPY protocol (COPY FROM STDIN via Npgsql) for ultra-fast data transfer.
Implemented topological dependency sorting using Kahn's Algorithm to automatically resolve table creation and insertion order based on foreign key relationships.

Engineered full schema and data replication supporting automated primary/foreign key creation, unique/check constraints, custom indexes, identity sequence syncing, and smart staging copy with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.
Designed a modern interactive terminal UI with Spectre.Console featuring connection status checks, table row estimation grids, real-time progress bars, and execution statistics.
